The '''Galdria system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was home to the [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as the [[Galdrian mustang]].<ref name="Xim" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Galdria system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square S-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
